author: bardic-inspiration
name: Warren Throne
summary: A goblin king holds court in a flooded shrine, guarded by his hexer and his boss.

parts.text: Water laps at the shrine's steps. On the altar sits a goblin in a crown of bent spoons, flanked by a hooded hexer and a scarred brute.

parts.trigger: The party steps onto the shrine's steps, or attacks from the water.

stages.name: Court
stages.turns: The king stays on the altar and shouts orders. The hexer curses the nearest caster; the boss holds the steps.
stages.transition: When the boss falls or the king is hit, the king leaves the altar.

stages.name: Rage
stages.turns: The king wades into melee beside the hexer, who stays behind him.
stages.transition: When the king is below half his Hit Points, the hexer flees for the Overflow.

stages.name: Last Stand
stages.turns: The king fights alone and never retreats.

parts.victory: The king falls, or yields his crown.

parts.title: The King's Hoard
parts.table:
| d4 | Treasure |
|---|---|
| 1 | A sack of 150 GP in tarnished coins |
| 2 | A {ref:equipment/potion-of-healing} in a cracked vial |
| 3 | A silver chalice worth 75 GP |
| 4 | The crown of bent spoons, worth 1 CP |

environment.note: Knee-deep water slows the party, and the altar gives the king cover.
